question: AB is the diameter of a circle with centre O. P be a point on it. If ∠AOP = 95°, then ∠OBP __________.
solution:
Given :

AB is a diameter of circle centre O,

Formula used : 

Linear pair angle, angle on straight line = 180°

**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5b0ec7113fbce8936fa5e4b8ce0c7fa493597c79303bb8d505d71a8a4f4c2a0.png] 

∠AOP = 95 °

∠POB = ( 180 ° - 95 °) = 85°

∆ POB = ∠P = ∠B ( Isosceles triangle )

⇒ ∠POB = 85° 

∆ POB = ∠POB + ∠ OBP + ∠ BPO = 180°

⇒ 180° = 85°+ 2 × ∠OBP

⇒ 95/2 = ∠OBP

⇒ 47.5° = ∠OBP** **

**The value of ****∠OBP is 47.5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**∠OBP = 1/2 × of ∠AOP

∠OBP = 1/2 × of 95 = 47.5
